item.title: eufy S4 Wall Light Cam Security Camera $200 with Free Shipping
item.description: The eufy S4 Wall Light Cam combines a 4K security camera with a wall light, featuring 60GHz radar detection, an RGB light and siren, and solar power. It operates with no monthly fee. The camera is available for $199.99 with a promo code and free shipping.

item.title: Weber Genesis C-335E Gas Grill with free shipping at $749.99
item.description: The Weber Genesis C-335E is a three-burner gas grill with a side burner and porcelain-enameled cast-iron cooking grates. It is available for $749.99 with free shipping, and may be priced lower in-store at Costco.

item.title: Chipolo Loop Tracker Drops to $33 at Amazon
item.description: The Chipolo Loop is a Bluetooth item tracker designed to help you locate keys, bags, and other essentials. It is currently available at Amazon for $33, which is its lowest price since launch.

item.title: Exerpeutic Under-Desk Exercise Bike $71.86 at Woot!
item.description: The Exerpeutic 2000M is a motorized under-desk exercise bike that provides electric leg and arm pedaling for home or office use. This deal offers it for $71.86 with free shipping for Prime members at Woot!.

item.title: BCANHOME 56-60" x 76" Frameless Sliding Shower Door for $509.99
item.description: This BCANHOME sliding shower door is sized 56-60 inches wide by 76 inches high and features a soft-close mechanism with a buffer damping system. It includes 10mm tempered glass, stainless steel anti-rust hardware, and an explosion-proof film. The door is priced at $509.99.

item.title: BCANHOME 61"x30" Freestanding Stone Bathtub with Drain for $1299.99
item.description: This freestanding solid surface stone bathtub measures 61 by 30 inches and includes an overflow and pop-up drain. It is currently available for $1299.99 at Wayfair.

item.title: BCANHOME Smart Toilet with Bidet and Auto Features for $409.99
item.description: This smart toilet includes a tankless bidet wash, auto-open lid and seat, heated seat, warm wash and dryer, soft closing, and remote control. It features a 1.28-gallon auto dual flush with a MaP 1000g powerful flush. The price is $409.99.

item.title: DESLOC C100 Plus Smart Door Lock with Keypad and Visual Display for $30
item.description: The DESLOC C100 Plus is a WiFi-enabled smart door lock featuring a keypad and visual display, offering app remote control, support for up to 100 PIN codes, and an auto-lock function. It is designed for front door use in homes and rentals, and is available in black. The lock is currently priced at $30 with free shipping.

item.title: Shintenchi 6x4 FT Steel Storage Shed with Window for $125.99 at Amazon
item.description: This outdoor storage shed from Shintenchi measures 6x4 feet and features a steel construction with a window and lockable single door. It is weather-resistant and suitable for storing garden tools and equipment. The shed is available for $125.99 with free shipping at Amazon.

item.title: Hummingbird Solar Lanterns for Outdoor Decor, $9.72
item.description: These solar-powered lanterns feature hummingbird designs and are waterproof for outdoor use. With a promo code at checkout, one lantern is priced at $9.72, while the hummingbird mom version is $10.99.

item.title: Echo 56V Cordless Mower with Battery and Charger Drops to $438.63
item.description: This Echo 56V cordless self-propelled lawn mower includes a 5.0Ah battery and charger. By adding a leaf blower to the cart and returning it, the mower's price drops to $438.63. Alternatively, ordering from the military store offers 10% off and free shipping if keeping both items.

item.title: UGREEN Nexode Pro 160W Charger with Smart Display Drops to $59.99
item.description: The UGREEN Nexode Pro 160W Charger features a smart display and is currently available for $59.99 with free shipping. This price matches a previous frontpage deal, offering a significant discount for a high-power charging solution.

item.title: Greenlee Battery Crimping Tool at $5,369.10
item.description: The Greenlee E12CCXL230 is a battery-powered crimping tool designed for heavy-duty electrical work. It is currently available for $5,369.10 on Amazon. This price reflects the listed cost of the tool.

item.title: Toro 60V Leaf Blower $130 Off at Lowe's
item.description: The Toro Flex-Force 60V leaf blower delivers strong blowing performance. Lowe's is currently offering it at a $130 discount, bringing the price down by nearly 40% ahead of Labor Day.

item.title: TempSpike Bluetooth Grill Thermometer Drops to $22.99 at Walmart
item.description: The TempSpike wireless Bluetooth grill thermometer from iTronics USA Inc. is available for $22.99 at Walmart.com. It features a 450-foot range and can upgrade any grill or smoker to a smart cooking device. Shipping is free with Walmart+ or on qualifying orders.

item.title: GiftCards.com $50 Merchant Gift Cards for $42.50 with code
item.description: GiftCards.com is offering select $50 merchant gift cards for $42.50 when the promo code GIFT50 is applied at checkout. The deal is valid through September 7 and includes brands such as Bertucci's and other food and dining options.

item.title: Milwaukee M18 FUEL PACKOUT Wet/Dry Vac and Impact Driver Bundle for $189
item.description: Home Depot offers the Milwaukee M18 FUEL PACKOUT 18V 2.5-gallon wet/dry vacuum bundled with an M18 FUEL 1/4-inch hex impact driver for $189. This is a one-day deal with free pickup or delivery.

item.title: Milwaukee M18 FUEL PACKOUT Wet/Dry Vacuum with 5.0 Ah Battery $189
item.description: The Milwaukee M18 FUEL PACKOUT 2.5 Gal. Cordless Wet/Dry Vacuum is a compact, powerful vacuum designed for job site cleanup. This deal includes the vacuum and an M18 5.0 Ah lithium-ion battery pack for $189, available for ship to store and delivery.

item.title: Nuwave Grill Air Fryer Combo with 100 Presets for $99.99
item.description: The Nuwave 15.5 Q Plug-In Grill Air Fryer Oven Combo combines grilling and air frying with sheath heaters for authentic char flavor. It features a 2024 convection system, 100 presets, and a smart probe, with a temperature range of 50-550°F. Available in stainless steel at Woot! for $99.99.

item.title: Fragess 600LBS Folding Camping Cot with Mattress for $59.99 at Woot!
item.description: This portable camping cot supports up to 600 pounds and includes a thick mattress. It folds for easy storage and transport, suitable for outdoor camping, office naps, or home use. The grey cot measures 75 by 28 by 13.8 inches and is available for $59.99 with free shipping for Amazon Prime members.

item.title: SKIL 16-inch String Trimmer Attachment for Multi-Head System at $56.96
item.description: This is the SKIL PWR CORE 40 16-inch string trimmer attachment, compatible with the SKIL Multi-Head System and the PLT1500C-13 power head. It is priced at $56.96 at Walmart, with free shipping available for Walmart+ members.

item.title: Royal Gourmet 30-Inch Charcoal Grill and Smoker for $99.99
item.description: This Royal Gourmet CD2030AN is a 30-inch charcoal grill that also functions as a deluxe BBQ smoker, suitable for picnics, camping, patios, and backyard cooking. The grill is available for $99.99 with free delivery from Woot.

item.title: Milwaukee M18 8-Tool Combo Kit with 2 Batteries and Charger for $649
item.description: This combo kit includes eight Milwaukee M18 cordless tools, two batteries, and a charger. It is currently available for $649 with free shipping or store pickup at Home Depot.

item.title: Greenworks 24V String Trimmer with Battery and Blades for $88
item.description: This cordless string trimmer from Greenworks operates on a 24V battery and includes a 4.0 Ah battery and 20 replacement blades. The trimmer is available at Amazon for $88.12 with free shipping.

item.title: Greenworks 24V Leaf Blower with Battery and Charger for $89.99
item.description: This cordless leaf blower delivers 270 CFM of air volume and comes with a 3.0 Ah battery and charger. The deal is available at Amazon for $89.99 with free shipping.

item.title: Empire 2-Piece Level Set at Home Depot for $19.97
item.description: This set includes a 24-inch aluminum I-beam level and a 12-inch compact box level. It is currently priced at $19.97 with free shipping or store pickup available.

item.title: DEWALT 31-Piece Security Bit Set with Case for $14.98 at Amazon
item.description: This DEWALT security screwdriver bit set includes 31 pieces and comes with a storage case. It is available for $14.98 at Amazon, with free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.

item.title: Eufy Wallet Tracker Hits Record Low at $25
item.description: The Eufy Wallet Tracker is a rechargeable Bluetooth tracker designed to help you locate your wallet, luggage, and other essentials. It is currently available for $25, which is a record-low price for this device.

item.title: Lazyboi Cordless Leaf Blower with 2 Batteries and Charger for $59.95
item.description: This cordless leaf blower operates on a 21V battery and includes two batteries and a charger. It is available in various colors for $59.95, down from the regular price of $89.99.

item.title: Cricut AutoPress 2 Heat Press Machine for $379
item.description: The Cricut AutoPress 2 is a 15x15 heat press machine designed for crafting and garment customization. This Amazon exclusive deal offers the machine at $379, with free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.
